# registry commands

Every `registry` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `registry:sync`

Run all registry sync commands (contracts, and entities if available).

```bash
bin/semitexa registry:sync
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `registry:sync:contracts`

Generate contract resolvers in src/registry/Contracts for interfaces with 2+ implementations.

```bash
bin/semitexa registry:sync:contracts
```
